title: AS2: EventDispatcher base class and addEventListener compile pattern
description: Flash 8 AS2 had mx.events.EventDispatcher as the base class for event handling. Goal: (1) verify the AS2 compiler correctly compiles 'import mx.events.EventDispatcher; class Foo extends EventDispatcher {}' — this is standard class inheritance, should already work; (2) verify addEventListener/removeEventListener/dispatchEvent method calls compile correctly (these are just ActionCallMethod sequences); (3) add 6 tests in __tests__/eventdispatcher.test.ts verifying that the common EventDispatcher patterns compile without error and emit correct ActionCallMethod opcodes. No runtime implementation needed — Flash Player provides the actual EventDispatcher.
